page_title: ETI 0-2 REN | St Etienne v Rennes 08/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Mathieu Vernice is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Here comes a substitution. Anthony Briancon (St Etienne) is brought on as a substitute for Dennis Appiah.
90+6' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90+5' Djyilian N'Guessan (St Etienne) unleashes a shot, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
90+2' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) makes a strong challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The free kick is delivered by Ludovic Blas (Rennes) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
85' Here's the change. Zuriko Davitashvili leaves the pitch and Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) comes on as a substitute.
85' Habib Beye has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) replacing Lorenz Assignon.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kazeem Olaigbe (Rennes) comes onto the pitch so that Djaoui Cisse can be given a rest.
84' 0 - 2 Goal! Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) scores after an assist by Adrien Truffert that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:2.
83' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Gautier Larsonneur easily deals with the threat.
82' Djyilian N'Guessan (St Etienne) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
77' Brice Samba (Rennes) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
76' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle. Mickael Nade (St Etienne) commits a foul after dangerous play.
76' Eirik Horneland has decided to make a change. Djyilian N'Guessan (St Etienne) replaces Lucas Stassin.
71' Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
69' Substitution. Arnaud Kalimuendo is replaced by Ismael Kone (Rennes).
69' Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Mathieu Vernice didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
66' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
64' The foul by Seko Fofana (Rennes) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Mathieu Vernice.
64' Pierre Cornud (St Etienne) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Brice Samba has no trouble gathering it.

64' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and St Etienne will have a corner.
62' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

61' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) tries his luck with a long-range shot from a rebound, but it isn't precise at all and the ball flies well wide of the right post towards the corner flag. Very poor shot. The ball goes out of play and St Etienne will have a goal kick.
59' That's the end of the game for Jordan James, who is replaced by Seko Fofana (Rennes).
56' The current number of corner kicks is 1:4.
50' Pierre Cornud (St Etienne) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
49' Rennes take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

48' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the left side of the goal. Gautier Larsonneur is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. Rennes win a corner kick.
48' Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' Eirik Horneland makes a switch. Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) is coming on in place of Augustine Boakye at the start of the second period.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Eirik Horneland gives a chance to Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) and Louis Mouton is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
43' Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

41' What a chance that is! Ludovic Blas (Rennes) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St Etienne.
40' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Gautier Larsonneur.
38' Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
38' St Etienne take a short corner kick.
38' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. It will be a corner kick for St Etienne.
34' Brice Samba displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

32' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) finds some space inside the box and latches on to a brilliant cross, but he wastes his chance as his shot goes way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and St Etienne will have a goal kick.
31' 1:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.

28' Lilian Brassier (Rennes) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and St Etienne will have a goal kick.
27' Jordan James (Rennes) takes the corner.
26' Jordan James (Rennes) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St Etienne.
26' Gautier Larsonneur leaps to intercept the corner kick from Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
23' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Mathieu Vernice lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
23' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
21' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
20' Louis Mouton (St Etienne) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Rennes are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
17' Today's referee Mathieu Vernice rightly decides to book Jordan James (Rennes) for his harsh tackle.
15' 0 - 1 GOAL! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) got to the ball in front of the goal and he couldn't miss from there. His strike went in off the crossbar. The score is 0:1.
14' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Augustine Boakye (St Etienne). The ball has crossed the sideline. St Etienne are taking a throw-in.
13' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) is caught offside!
13' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
12' Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
9' Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
7' Rennes work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

7' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Mousa Tamari (Rennes) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
5' The linesman raises his flag. Mousa Tamari (Rennes) is adjudged offside.

3' CHANCE! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and St Etienne will have a goal kick.
2' Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Rennes will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Mathieu Vernice.
